messages:
Gina (Support): Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 403s started ~10:12 UTC. Tickets from Acme and ShopStream. Error payload: 'permission_denied: invalid credentials'. Looks correlated with this morning's signing key rotation. Escalating to SRE.

Ken (Oncall): I'm on it. Seeing a sudden jump in 403 responses from auth-proxy in prod at 10:12:08. Latency OK, but auth failures spike. Pulling rotation logs and edge cache stats now.

Maria (Auth): Checking rotator: rotation job completed at 10:11:57 for key_id=rot-2026-03-17-10. Canary succeeded but eu-west-1 reported a JWKS fetch error and fell back to empty set. Suspect JWKS cache TTL and backfill timing mismatch.

Rahul (SRE): Repro attempt: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <old-token>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings` => 403, auth-proxy logs: `ERROR jwt_verify: kid rot-2026-03-17-10 not present in jwks`

Gina (Support): Customers hitting pay-as-you-go endpoints; several reported immediate billing failures when requests are rejected. We've got a sev2 if this is widespread. Any quick mitigation?

Maria (Auth): We do have a fallback that accepts old kid for 24h, but the rotator's backfill removed the previous JWKS earlier due to an off-by-one TTL bug. I'm starting an emergency rollback to previous active key (rot-2026-03-17-09).

Ken (Oncall): Initiating rollback now. Thao, can you stop the publisher and hold canary promotions? Runbook step: `stop key-publisher && set-active-key rot-2026-03-17-09`

Thao (Eng): Holding promotions and disabling publisher. Running: `/bin/auth-rotator rollback --target=rot-2026-03-17-09 --force`

deploy-bot: auth-rotator: rollback triggered by Thao at 10:18:03 UTC. Rolling active key to rot-2026-03-17-09. Propagation to edge caches in progress.

Rahul (SRE): Customer workaround noted in tickets: reissue API key from dashboard or switch to legacy verification for short term. Communicated but not scalable for many tenants.

Maria (Auth): Patching rotator: change JWKS cache TTL to 15m and ensure old keys retained for 48h after rotation. Patch to be deployed to rotation service in ~25m after validation. We'll need a postmortem and rollback gating added.

Ken (Oncall): Monitoring: 403 rate decreased from 42% to ~4% over last 3 minutes post-rollback. Keeping rollback live until hotfix validated. Gina, please notify support to send templated update to affected customers with workaround and ETA.

Gina (Support): Will send templated update now — marking affected tickets as 'mitigated, rollback in progress, hotfix planned'. Adding customers to private status update channel. :thumbsup:

Maria (Auth): Note for postmortem: root cause appears to be TTL/backfill race in keybackfill worker causing premature old-key purge during a rapid rotation. Also improve canary failure alerting to block global promote.

Ken (Oncall): Good. Keep thread updated with propagation metrics. If we see any regression, escalate to platform leads.

Gina (Support): Updating tickets and the status page. Will close updates in 30m if no regression observed.
